'''Carl Mike Hardy Cloud Car Rampage''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Red 32's Star Wars CCG Site]] as '''Cloud Car Rampage'''. [[Carl Mike Hardy]] posted it in 1999. It was listed under Bespin & Beyond.

* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

== Strategy ==

I chose to play this deck on Cloud City mainly as a defence against Dark Deal... As long as you maintain an early and permanent presence at Bespin: Cloud City, you won't have to worry about the Dark hitting you with the Deal of Darkness... The KEY is Manuever Flaps! With that card your Cloud Cars are each power 4 (5 in the clouds) and forfiet 5!!! With that kind of power, the Dark won't even bother with you at the Cloud City exterior sites... Heaven help him if he's got sites like the Dowtown Plaza and Porttown District.... Even with Trooper Assault, you should have the upper hand! I like Devaronian's because their power 3 on Cloud City... Their also pilots for the Cars and they can play Sabbac pretty well. Goo Nee Tay with the H'Nemthe will keep Vader at bay for a while, so, you can set up your forces. Additionally, you can send both to the Barganing Table to cancel a drain! How elegantly simple... All in all this deck uses 4 rares total... Which is extremely cheap... Considering it's impact potential!
